summary: Connect AI inventories, assessments, controls and reporting to enterprise risk processes. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: AI risk register training helps intermediate risk, governance and assurance practitioners document AI exposures and link them to enterprise risk processes. You practise building inventories, recording context and impacts, applying scoring criteria, assigning owners and treatments, and mapping risks to enterprise categories and appetite. Exercises also cover change and incident tracking and management reporting, using spreadsheets and representative GRC workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate practitioners who maintain AI risk records or connect AI oversight with enterprise risk processes. It suits professionals who need to challenge assessments, assign accountable owners and report material AI exposures.
prerequisites: Prior experience with risk, governance or assurance processes is expected. Familiarity with AI system use or review is useful. Programming is not required; exercises focus on risk records, assessment evidence and spreadsheet-based tracking.
